% Abstract of the synthetic skim_extract fixture.
\begin{abstract}
Edge caches miss often when request patterns shift~\cite{Doe2029}.
We present \examplesys{}, a cache that predicts the next request from the last ten.
On a synthetic trace, \examplesys{} serves 59.25\% of requests from the cache (Table~\ref{tab:hits}).
\end{abstract}
